name: Dawn * Slave ~Kisezu Toriko to Sareta Hime no Tokoro to Kokoro to Yoridokoro~
original_name: DAWN＊SLAVE ～期せず擒とされた姫の處と心と拠～
source:
When our guy found out that the princess he loves is going to be married out of country in a month, he hired a sorceress to help him kidnap her. The sorceress told him that a hero will come to rescue the princess in one month, so that is all the time he has to love or play with her. What will he do?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主角得知心爱的公主将在一个月后远嫁国外，于是雇用女巫帮助自己绑架她。女巫告诉他，一个月后英雄会来营救公主，因此他只有这段时间爱她，或和她玩乐。他会怎么做？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
